## Purpose
Hooks for pages that show a background run. A page never owns the stream; it folds the run's event log into its own view state, so opening mid-run, after a reload, or long after the end all give the same timeline.

## Responsibilities
- **`useTrackedRun(id)`.**
- **`useRunReducer(id, reduce, init)`:**
  - subscribes to `useRunLogVersion`;
  - applies only the events added since the last render;
  - resets when the log shrinks or the id changes.
- **`useRunView(id)`:**
  - `focusRun` while mounted;
  - `ensureRun`;
  - `missing` when the server does not know the run;
  - marks finished runs seen.
- **`useElapsed(since, live, until)`** ticks every second while live.

## Key elements
`useRunReducer`, `useRunView`, `useTrackedRun`, `useElapsed`.

## Control flow
React hooks.
